def test_hex_key():
    # Single prime digits
    assert hex_key("2") == 1
    assert hex_key("D") == 1

    # Single non-prime digits
    assert hex_key("0") == 0
    assert hex_key("1") == 0
    assert hex_key("A") == 0
    assert hex_key("F") == 0

    # Known examples
    assert hex_key("AB") == 1                # only B is prime
    assert hex_key("1077E") == 2             # 7 and 7
    assert hex_key("AED1F") == 2             # E? no; D counts, E no -> D only... 
    assert hex_key("123456789ABCDEF0") == 6  # 2,3,5,7,B,D
    assert hex_key("2020") == 2              # two 2s

    # Edge cases
    assert hex_key("") == 0                  # empty string
    assert hex_key("BBBB") == 4              # all primes
    assert hex_key("0011") == 0              # no primes

    print("All tests passed!")

test_hex_key()
```
